title: OperationRequest
description: SIE Operator receptor archetype — operation request contract. Defines the shape of an operation trigger received by the operator's run-operation mechanism. Client mechanisms wire an Effector to this receptor via an Interaction to declare operability.

mechanismAscriptionId.description: The ascription ID of the client mechanism to execute.

operationInput.description: The operation input — validated against the mechanism's trigger receptor archetype schema at execution time.
